pairs: Quod factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam contra Palæstinos,
The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah, the prophet, against the Philistines,
“Behold, waters will rise up from the north,
and they will be like an inundating torrent,
et operient terram et plenitudinem ejus,
and they will cover the land and its plenitude,
and all the inhabitants of the land will wail,
a strepitu pompæ armorum, et bellatorum ejus,
before the uproar of a procession of weapons and of his soldiers,
a commotione quadrigarum ejus, et multitudine rotarum illius.
before the commotion of his four-horse chariots and the multitude of his wheels.
Non respexerunt patres filios manibus dissolutis,
The fathers have not looked back for the sons, because of feebleness of hands,
pro adventu diei in quo vastabuntur omnes Philisthiim,
because of the arrival of the day on which all the Philistines will be devastated,
and Tyre and Sidon will be destroyed,
et Sidon cum omnibus reliquis auxiliis suis:
with all the rest of their helpers.
For the Lord has depopulated the Philistines,
the remnant of the island of Cappadocia.
along with the remnant of their valley.
And how long will you continue to be cut down?
O sharp sword of the Lord,
how long will you be without rest?
But how can it find rest,
cum Dominus præceperit ei adversus Ascalonem,
when the Lord has ordered it against Ashkelon
and when a task has been appointed to it there?”
